<thought>Identify a template for the amide‑forming step (carboxylic acid + aniline → amide). Then find a template for the Doebner modification (aryl aldehyde + malonic acid → α,β‑unsaturated acid). Finally locate a template for sulfonamide formation (aryl sulfonyl chloride + aniline → sulfonamide). These three templates will be used to build the three‑step retrosynthetic tree.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["carboxylic acids"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["amides"],
  "bonds_formed": ["C-N"],
  "bonds_broken": ["C-O"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
